nameEn: Executive and legislative organs, financial and fiscal affairs, external affairs
description: Administration, operation or support of executive and legislative organs; financial, fiscal and external affairs. Includes office of the chief executive at all levels of government; legislative bodies at all levels of government; advisory, administrative and political staffs attached to chief executives and legislatures; libraries and other reference services serving these bodies.
includes: office of the chief executive (head of state, governor, mayor, etc.) at all levels of government
legislative bodies (parliament, assemblies, councils) at all levels of government
advisory, administrative and political staffs attached to executives and legislatures
permanent and temporary committees and commissions established by or acting on behalf of the executive or legislature
ministries of finance and revenue authorities (tax administration, customs)
ministries of foreign affairs and diplomatic missions, embassies and consulates abroad
information and cultural services intended for distribution beyond national boundaries
excludes: ministries handling specific functional areas (classified to the corresponding function)
